ambient: Somebody through there laughs at something you didn't hear.
The light in there changes slightly, the way light does when people move.
Somebody crosses the doorway from one side to the other and doesn't glance out.
description: A door standing open onto the place this whole building is the entrance to. It's bright and it's occupied and it's going well. Nobody in it's looking this way. The doorway is the width of a doorway and you're on this side of it.
name: What Is Through There

looks: Open. It has been open the whole time.
No sill, no step. The floor goes straight through.
You can see a good deal of the room from here and not the far end.
objects.name: the doorway

looks: At ease. They have been there long enough to be at ease.
You know one of them. You know two of them.
None of them has looked out and none of them is avoiding it.
objects.name: the people through there

weather: Warm air coming through the doorway, carrying the smell of somewhere lived in.
